'''Illip''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan, or [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. One of its members was [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]], a Hutt who held the title of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] at some point before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==History==
One of the many [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], the Illip clan produced [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]], a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] Hutt who took the occupation of being a scientist instead of a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], uncommon for a Hutt.

During the [[Galactic War]], Juvard was enlisted by [[Supreme Mogul]] [[Toborro]] to aid in the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel's]] [[Conquest of Makeb|invasion of]] [[Makeb]]. Though, Juvard soon realized that Toborro was mad and defected to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], allying the Illip clan with the Republic. Though, after the invasion, Juvard became the official liaison for the Hutt Cartel and the Galactic Republic.

==Behind the scenes==
While the Illip kajidic itself has never been mentioned, its existence is implied by the name of Juvard Illip Oggurobb. According to ''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'', the [[cuirvas]] (or middle name) of a Hutt identified their clan.<ref name="GG11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref>
